deals.title: EcoFlow Delta 3 Max 2,048Wh Portable Power Station for $879 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: At $879, this EcoFlow Delta 3 Max is below its 90-day average of $927 at Amazon. It pairs a 2,048Wh LiFePO4 battery with 2,400W of continuous output, and X-Boost mode raises that to 3,400W for higher-draw appliances. It recharges from 0% to 80% in about 1.1 hours and can be paired with optional solar panels. Shipping is free. deals.title: KitchenAid 5.5-Quart Bowl-Lift Stand Mixer for $300 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: Today only at Target, you can get the KitchenAid KSM55 stand mixer in four different colors for just $300. This is a great price as you'd pay as much as $500 for this model elsewhere today. It has a 5.5-quart bowl that can handle 11 dozen cookies per batch or over 7-lbs. of bread dough. Shipping is free and Target Circle Card holders can save an additional 5%. Buy Now at Target Features 5.5-quart stainless steel bowl 11 speeds, including a 1/2 speed for folding 500W motor 3-point locking bowl-lift design Includes coated flat beater, coated dough hook, and 6-wire whip Compatible with 10+ optional attachments sold separately

deals.title: EcoFlow Delta 3 Max 2048Wh Portable Power Station for $849 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: As one of Best Buy's daily deals, this EcoFlow Delta 3 Max power station drops to $849. That's $30 less than you'd pay elsewhere today. It can run appliances rated up to 3,400W in X-Boost mode and recharges to 80% in about 68 minutes from a wall outlet. The battery is rated for 3,000 charge cycles and the unit carries a 5-year warranty. My Best Buy members get free shipping on all orders (it's free to join). This deal ends today. deals.title: JBL 8" Powered Portable Bluetooth Speaker Kit w/ Cover, Stand, & Cable for $350 + shipping varies
deals.sourceText: B&H Photo's JBL IRX108BT speaker kit is $196 off at $350 during its Holiday Savings. The bundle adds a water-resistant slip cover, a steel tripod stand that adjusts from 3 to 6.5', and a 20' XLR cable to the powered 8" speaker. The speaker also offers Bluetooth streaming and two mic/line inputs for use as a small PA system. Buy Now at B&H Photo Video Features 8" woofer with 1300W amplifier Frequency response of 54Hz to 20kHz with 124dB max volume Bluetooth 5.0 streaming, plus 2 mic/line inputs & XLR output 4 EQ presets, bass boost, & built-in feedback suppression Includes water-resistant cover, tripod stand (3 to 6.5' adjustable), & 20' XLR cable
